_comment: URA staff-auth realm — reference config for wiring a real OIDC provider to the staff dashboards. Verified end-to-end against Keycloak 26 (authorization-code + PKCE S256, RS256 tokens). Import with `start-dev --import-realm`. Passwords are placeholders: set real ones via the console or kcadm before use, and change the redirect URIs to your deployment's origin. See App/deploy/keycloak/README.md.

clients.name: URA Tax Assistant (staff web)
clients._redirectUris_comment: Replace with your deployment origin. The path must be exactly /signin/callback. Keep localhost for dev.
clients._protocolMappers_comment: The audience mapper is load-bearing: without it Keycloak does not put this client in `aud`, and the backend rejects every token with 'audience mismatch'.

_users_comment: Demo officers. Passwords are placeholders — set real ones before use. Roles arrive in access tokens as realm_access.roles, which is where the backend probes by default (App/backend/app/auth/dependencies.py).
